summary: Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter
description: The bug Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter. How to reproduce - Execute the command: /give @s jigsaw - Open the jigsaw block (displaying the user interface) - Type in any of the text boxes, characters: or {} (invalid unicode characters blocking the "done" button) - Press the enter key The game crashes Crash report 1.14.3-pre3 : [^crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt] Description: keyPressed event handler n: Non [a-z0-9/._-] character in path of location: minecraft:empty at qt. (SourceFile:38) at qt. (SourceFile:43) at dbo.d(SourceFile:44) at dbo.b(SourceFile:35) at dbo.keyPressed(SourceFile:106) at cvm.a(SourceFile:410) at cvm$$Lambda$3043/1332786777.run(Unknown Source) at czx.wrapScreenError(SourceFile:441) at cvm.a(SourceFile:408) at cvm$$Lambda$1477/601932288.invoke(Unknown Source) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWKeyCallbackI.callback(GLFWKeyCallbackI.java:37) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwPollEvents(GLFW.java:3101) at cuh.l(SourceFile:425) at cuh.c(SourceFile:283) at cvo.b(SourceFile:1023) at cvo.e(SourceFile:976) at cvo.b(SourceFile:411) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:154)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Execute the command: `/give @s jigsaw`.
3. Place the jigsaw block on the ground and open it by right-clicking (or using the equivalent action for your control scheme).
4. In any of the text boxes within the jigsaw block's user interface, type invalid characters such as `{}`.
5. Press the Enter key to submit the input.
6. Observe that the game crashes upon pressing Enter with these invalid characters in the text box.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.14.2, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 4, 1.14.3
Observed Behavior: When invalid characters are entered into the jigsaw block's user interface and the enter key is pressed, the game crashes. To reproduce this issue, first execute the command `/give @s jigsaw` to obtain a jigsaw block. Place the jigsaw block in your world and open its user interface. In any of the text boxes within the interface, input invalid unicode characters such as `:` or `{}`. These characters will prevent the "done" button from becoming active. When you press the enter key after entering these invalid characters, the game crashes. This behavior was observed in version 1.14.3-pre3 and a crash report is available at [^crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt]. The error message in the crash report indicates that there was an issue with non-[a-z0-9/._-] characters in the path of location: `minecraft:empty`. This bug highlights a critical flaw in how invalid unicode characters are handled within the jigsaw block's input fields, leading to game instability.
Expected Behavior: When invalid characters such as `{` or `}` are entered into the jigsaw block's input fields and the enter key is pressed, the game should not crash. Instead, it should display an error message indicating that these characters are not allowed, and the user interface should remain functional, allowing the player to correct their input without any need for restarting the game.
